name: Focus Friend
summary:
When you Focus, your Bean will Focus.

Your Bean is a smart bean. If you let them concentrate, they’ll build something special. Complete your focus session, and Bean will reveal their creation and use it to decorate their room!

If you interrupt your Bean by turning off the timer, they'll be really sad. A very sad Bean indeed.

Perfect for anyone who struggles with long sessions of concentration. Focus Friend will even help you with getting started on your tasks and getting into the flow of your work or studying.

Decorate your room with beautiful colors and themes of the furniture you earn by completing your focus sessions!

Customize your Bean to be a Coffee Bean, Edamame Bean, Pinto Bean, or even Hank and John Green... Or rather Hank and John Bean!

Stay Focused, Have Fun, Drink Water, and Don't Forget to be Awesome~
